Books taught me a lot…yet not as much as lessons the hard way.

The one sentence here sums up all 39 years of hard lessons I’ve learned:

"I have seen so much bullshit during sunny days, that I know...u cannot trust a motherfucker until u have seen how he walks through a storm."
